concerns.text: Task T001 creates directory tree under `projects/PROJ-001‑assessing-statistical-power` instead of the required `projects/PROJ-234‑assessing-statistical-power` as mandated by the specification and constitution (see spec.md and constitution Principle VII). This path mismatch violates the project identifier constraint.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Core utility library (single module group):T004
concerns.text: Task T004 claims to implement robust utilities (api_client with exponential back‑off and DataFetchError) but the underlying `utils/api_client.py` lacks exponential back‑off and does not raise `DataFetchError` on permanent failures, breaking FR‑001/FR‑002 error‑handling requirements.

Task T005’s ingestion script bypasses the `utils.api_client` wrapper, filters on a non‑existent `url` field, and therefore produces an empty `filtered_datasets.json`. This undermines FR‑001 and FR‑002 (correct OpenML retrieval and filtering) and fails to meet the acceptance criterion that the filtered list be non‑empty.

The verification step for T005 references a unit test `tests/unit/test_dataset_metadata_schema.py` that does not exist in the repository, making the acceptance criterion untestable and effectively dropped.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 4 – Publication parsing & statistical‑parameter extraction (User Story 2):T006
concerns.text: Task T006 lacks any test asserting that extraction precision and recall meet SC‑005 (≥ 0.9). Consequently FR‑011’s success metric (precision/recall thresholds) is not verifiably covered, constituting a weakening of the functional requirement.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Project scaffolding & core configuration:T001 verification
concerns.text: The verification for T001 checks for `.gitkeep` files but does not verify that the top‑level project directory name matches the required `PROJ-234‑assessing-statistical-power` identifier, leaving a constitutional violation unchecked.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Core utility library (single module group):T004 verification
concerns.text: Verification for T004 only runs unit tests; because the underlying utilities are incorrect (see concerns above), the task does not actually satisfy FR‑001/FR‑002 error‑handling requirements, representing an orphaned verification that weakens the functional guarantee.
